GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (26 Jan 48) CCS
(SCAPIN - 1744/5)
APO 500
26 January 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Control of Radio Communications.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 676.3 (14 Jul 47)CCS (SCAPIN 1744), dated 14 July 1947, subject: Control of Radio Communications, as amended.
2. Inclosure 1 is a combined list of all Japanese fixed and land radio stations.
3. Inclosure 2 is a combined list of SCAP Registry Number of all Japanese ship radio stations and an alphabetical list of all Japanese coastal and marine beacon stations.
4. Inclosures 1 and 2 of this memorandum include all the Japanese radio stations that were authorized by the reference memoranda and all additions, deletions and changes that have been subsequently authorized by memoranda to the Ministry of Communications to 1 January 1948. The authorizations of the stations listed in these inclosures are reaffirmed by this memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
2 Incls
1. List of Japanese Radio Stations
2. List of Japanese Ship and Coastal Radio Stations
